decisions.location: Introduction; Experiment 1 Results and Discussion; Experiment 2 Results and Discussion; General Discussion; References (all on line 1)
decisions.quote: In summary, Experiment 2 replicated the findings of Lu et al. (1993) in showing that rats can acquire identity matching using a successive discrimination procedure with odor stimuli, and extended their findings to demonstrate generalized identity matching to novel odor stimuli using unreinforced probe conditions.
decisions.reason: While Experiment 1 systematically replicates Urcuioli (2008) (shipped row 2399, doi: 10.1901/jeab.2008.90-257, on emergent associative symmetry in pigeons), Experiment 2 is designed and reported as an empirical replication and extension of Lu, Slotnick, and Silberberg (1993) (Physiology & Behavior, 53:795-804, doi: 10.1016/0031-9384(93)90191-h) using a separate sample of rats trained on olfactory identity relations in a successive go/no-go olfactometer procedure and tested on novel odor identity probes. The Experiment 2 Results and Discussion explicitly state that 'Experiment 2 replicated the findings of Lu et al. (1993) in showing that rats can acquire identity matching using a successive discrimination procedure with odor stimuli, and extended their findings to demonstrate generalized identity matching to novel odor stimuli using unreinforced probe conditions.' This is a distinct original work and finding from shipped row 2399. Prior adjudication/state files do not exist for this work.
